ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central black pigmentation forming a wide anchor shape; lateral lobes are primarily white with localized dark linear and punctate markings; extreme lateral tips exhibit clusters of off-white circular intensity.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate interior angle of 95-100 degrees and a significant depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations along the trailing edge, with several prominent high-amplitude jagged notches on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a slight concave sweep toward the notch and a convex curve approaching the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groups (barnacles) on both distal tips, most prominent on the right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed in the white fields, predominantly oriented vertically or at slight diagonals.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep jagged irregularities and missing tissue sections on the trailing edge of the right lobe; dense barnacle colonization on lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: White water spray and splashing pixels occlude the central base/peduncle region.
